## Project Overview

**Purpose:** India's trusted CDSCO-approved smart medicine assistant powered by Google Gemini AI. Provides medicine information, dosage safety checks, AI-powered multimodal chat, prescription analysis, and clinical decision support for Indian healthcare context.

**Target Users:**
- Elderly patients and caregivers (primary - elderly-friendly mode built-in)
- General public seeking medicine information
- Healthcare professionals for quick reference
- Pharmacists for alternative lookup

**Current Project Maturity:** **MVP / Phase 1 Complete** — Core medicine platform, dosage safety engine, clinical rules engine, and AI chatbot are functional. Backend uses MongoDB with JWT auth (admin pre-seeded). Frontend is vanilla ES Modules with no build step.

**Technology Stack:**
| Layer | Technology |
|-------|------------|
| Frontend | Vanilla JS (ES Modules), CSS Custom Properties, Font Awesome 6, Inter Font |
| Backend | FastAPI (Python 3.11+), Uvicorn, Motor (async MongoDB) |
| Database | MongoDB (collections: users, audit_logs, symptom_checks, medications) |
| AI | Google Gemini 1.5 Flash (multimodal: text + image) |
| Auth | JWT (HS256), bcrypt password hashing, access token in memory + HttpOnly refresh cookie, auto-refresh |
| Deployment | Static frontend (any CDN), Docker-ready backend |

## Current Architecture

### Frontend

**Technologies:** ES Modules, CSS Grid/Flexbox, CSS Custom Properties for theming, no bundler required.

**Main Modules:**
| Module | Path | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| App Orchestrator | `js/app.js` | Entry point, initializes all components, handles medicine selection, auth state |
| Configuration | `js/config.js` | App constants, Gemini API config, pharmacy URLs, image constraints |
| Medicine Database | `js/data/medicineDB.js` | 12 CDSCO medicines with full metadata (dosage by age, alternatives, symptoms) |
| Helpers | `js/utils/helpers.js` | `debounce`, `escapeHtml` (XSS prevention), `showToast`, `formatDate`, `throttle` |
| Storage | `js/utils/storage.js` | localStorage wrappers (getItem, setItem, removeItem) |

**Components (`js/components/`):**
| Component | File | Features |
|-----------|------|----------|
| Search | `search.js` | Live debounced search, category filter, suggestions dropdown, keyboard nav |
| Medicine Detail | `medicineDetail.js` | Header, dosage badges, age-based table, daily timeline, side effects, alternatives, store links, safety check form |
| Company List | `companyList.js` | Manufacturer filter chips with medicine counts |
| ChatBot | `chatBot.js` | Gemini multimodal chat, API key management, history persistence, image upload, quick-prompt chips |
| Auth | `auth.js` | Login/Register/Profile/Settings modals, elderly/high-contrast/font toggles, Clear All Data (SRS §8.4) |
| Scanner | `scanner.js` | Medicine image upload (drag-drop), prescription upload (image/PDF), prescription text analysis |
| Symptom Checker | `symptomChecker.js` | Symptom report submission to backend |
| Admin | `admin.js` | Admin dashboard (stats, users, audit log) with admin login |
| Clinical Findings | `clinicalFindings.js` | Renders safety assessment findings with severity badges, evidence attribution, confidence scores |

**Current Capabilities:**
- 4-page tabbed interface: Medicine, Image Scanner, Prescription, Symptom Checker
- 5 modals: Login/Register, Profile, Settings, About, Admin
- Responsive down to 320px, elderly mode (1.1rem base), high contrast, 3 font sizes
- Full keyboard navigation, ARIA labels/roles throughout
- Content-Security-Policy meta tag restricting sources

### Backend

**Technologies:** FastAPI, Motor (async MongoDB), PyJWT, Passlib[bcrypt], Pydantic v2, python-dotenv.

**APIs (all under `/api/`):**
| Domain | Endpoints |
|--------|-----------|
| Health | `GET /`, `GET /health` |
| Auth | `POST /api/auth/register`, `POST /api/auth/login`, `POST /api/auth/logout` |
| Medicine | `GET /api/medicine/search`, `GET /api/medicine/{med_id}`, `GET /api/medicine/{med_id}/alternatives`, `POST /api/medicine/upload` |
| Prescription | `POST /api/prescription/upload`, `POST /api/prescription/analyze` |
| AI Chat | `POST /api/chat` (stub — returns relevant medicines, expects frontend Gemini) |
| Companies | `GET /api/company`, `GET /api/company/{company_name}` |
| Profile | `GET /api/profile`, `PUT /api/profile` |
| Admin | `GET /api/admin/stats`, `GET /api/admin/users`, `POST /api/admin/medicines`, `GET /api/admin/audit` |
| Symptom | `POST /api/symptom-check` |
| Safety | `POST /api/safety/dosage-check` (requires auth) |

**Services:**
- **Upload Service:** Medicine images → `uploads/medicine_images/`, prescriptions → `uploads/prescriptions/` (5MB limit, JPEG/PNG/WEBP/PDF)
- **Audit Logging:** All actions logged to `audit_logs` collection with user, action, resource, timestamp
- **Auth Service:** JWT tokens (30-min default), bcrypt hashing, admin role guard

**Safety Engine (`backend/safety_engine.py`):**
- `DosageSafetyEngine` class with `calculate_daily_exposure()` (frequency → daily multiplier) and `evaluate()` method
- Loads medication safety thresholds from MongoDB `medications` collection (falls back to in-memory MEDICINES)
- Returns `DosageAssessment` with risk level, daily exposure, reference min/max, evidence attribution
- **Integrates Clinical Rules Engine** — runs 6 rules, attaches findings + overall clinical severity to assessment

**Clinical Rules Engine (`backend/clinical_rules/`):**
| Rule | File | Triggers On |
|------|------|-------------|
| Pediatric | `pediatric_rule.py` | Patient age < 18, dose > pediatric_max |
| Weight-Based | `weight_rule.py` | mg/kg > max_mg_per_kg (default 20), weight < 40kg |
| Elderly | `elderly_rule.py` | Patient age ≥ 65 |
| Pregnancy | `pregnancy_rule.py` | Patient pregnant, med pregnancy_category C/D/X |
| Renal | `renal_rule.py` | Patient has renal/kidney condition + med renal_adjustment=true |
| Hepatic | `hepatic_rule.py` | Patient has hepatic/liver condition + med hepatic_adjustment=true |
| Drug Interaction | `interaction_rule.py` | Patient on concurrent medications with known interactions |
| Source Conflict | `source_conflict_rule.py` | Conflicting evidence across dosage/interaction sources |

Each rule returns `ClinicalFinding` with: ruleType, severity (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/CRITICAL), finding, recommendation, evidence (sourceName, sourceUrl, evidenceTier, confidenceScore), triggered boolean.

## AI Integration

**Gemini Integration (`js/components/chatBot.js`):**
- Model: `gemini-1.5-flash` via `generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models`
- Multimodal: text + base64-encoded image (inline_data)
- System instruction enforces: CDSCO-only scope, plain English, bullet lists, **mandatory disclaimer on every response**
- Conversation history: last 10 turns for context
- Safety settings: BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE for dangerous content & harassment
- Generation config: temperature 0.7, topP 0.9, maxOutputTokens 800

**Current AI Capabilities:**
- Text Q&A about medicines (dosage, side effects, interactions, pregnancy, elderly dosing)
- Image analysis (identify medicine from photo via Gemini Vision)
- Medicine context awareness (current medicine passed from detail view)
- Chat history persistence in localStorage (toggleable)
- Quick-prompt chips for common queries

**Existing Limitations:**
- No RAG / backend knowledge retrieval (backend `/api/chat` is stub)
- API key stored only in localStorage (no server-side key management)
- No streaming responses
- No function calling / tool use
- Backend safety engine not yet connected to chat (separate safety check panel in UI)

14. **Prescription Analyzer Enhancement** — OCR extraction, medicine/dosage/frequency detection, safety engine integration (dosage check, interactions, clinical rules)
15. **Adverse Drug Reaction Reporting** — ADR CRUD, severity levels (Mild/Moderate/Severe/Critical), outcome tracking, stats dashboard with top reactions
16. **Patient Safety Score** — Multi-medication risk aggregation, visual safety gauge (donut chart), severity breakdown, top 5 concerns
17. **Emergency Profile & QR Card** — Emergency profile CRUD, QR code generation (base64 PNG), public view endpoint, structured emergency data
18. **PWA & Offline Mode** — Service worker with cache strategies, offline read-only mode, install prompt, app shortcuts, background sync, push notifications with VAPID
19. **Database Schema Expansion** — 13 collections with validation, indexes, migrations, admin database management endpoints
20. **Phase 1 Auth Validation & API Standards** — Implemented validation utilities, request/response Pydantic models, consistent error/success response formats, audit logging service, rate limiting on auth endpoints, preserved backward compatibility. Created `backend/utils/validators.py`, `docs/API_SPEC.md`, updated response models, added Phase 1 test coverage
21. **Phase 2 Dosage Safety API** — Created dedicated `/api/safety/dosage-check` endpoint with Pydantic validation, clinical rules engine integration, audit logging, rate limiting, and standardized responses
22. **Phase 2 Safety Score API** — Created `/api/safety/score` endpoint for multi-medication safety scoring with risk categorization, severity breakdown, and visual gauge data
23. **Phase 2 Drug Interaction API** — Created `/api/interactions/check` endpoint for pairwise drug-drug interaction checking with severity classification and recommendations
24. **Phase 2 Request/Response Models** — Extended `models/safety.py` with `SafetyScoreRequest`, `SafetyScoreResponse`, `DosageSafetyRequest`, `DosageSafetyResponse`, `DrugInteractionRequest`, `DrugInteractionResponse` models
25. **Phase 2 API Routes Organization** — Created modular route structure in `backend/api/routes/` with `dosage.py` and `interactions.py` modules
26. **Phase 2 Tests** — Created `tests/test_phase2_dosage.py` with comprehensive test coverage for all Phase 2 endpoints
27. **Phase 2 Documentation** — Updated `docs/API_SPEC.md` with complete Phase 2 endpoint specifications, request/response models, and rate limiting info

**Current Implementation Status:**
- Frontend: **Production-ready** for all features (Features 1-10 complete)
- Backend: **Functional** with integrated database-driven safety checks, all 10 features + database admin tools
- Database: **Seeded** with 500 medications safety dataset, 13 collections with validation, indexes, and migrations
- AI: **Frontend-only** Gemini integration (no backend RAG)
- Auth: **Complete JWT flow** (access/refresh tokens, auto-refresh, session resume)
- PWA: **Complete** (service worker, offline mode, install prompt, push notifications)
- Deployment: **Not configured** (no Dockerfile, no CI/CD, no production env)

## Technical Debt

### High Priority
| Item | Description | Impact |
|------|-------------|--------|
| **Mock authentication replacement** | Phase 1 uses localStorage session + backend JWT but frontend auth.js does mock login. Need full JWT flow: store token, attach to requests, handle 401, refresh. | Security, production readiness |
| **Expansion of Medication DB** | Currently only 12 medicines in memory. Need to reach 100+ for clinical relevance. | Usefulness, scale |
| **Source conflict resolution** | Multiple sources (DailyMed, CDSCO, manufacturer) may have different dosage limits. No reconciliation logic exists. | Evidence quality, safety |
| **API hardening** | No rate limiting, no request validation beyond Pydantic, CORS = `*`, no security headers beyond CSP. | Production security |

### Medium Priority
| Item | Description | Impact |
|------|-------------|--------|
| **Frontend-backend auth integration** | Frontend stores `mediguide_token` but doesn't consistently send it (only safety check does). Chat, profile, uploads should use it. | Feature completeness |
| **Error handling standardization** | Mix of `showToast`, console.error, inline error divs. No global error boundary or structured error codes. | Maintainability, UX |
| **TypeScript migration** | Large vanilla JS codebase. TypeScript would catch bugs in `medicineDB.js`, `chatBot.js`, `app.js` orchestration. | Developer velocity, correctness |
